pull.title: guix: update time-machine
pull.body:
Update to [637a34743d87b25d39f4a6c685b52b49b703e59a](https://codeberg.org/guix/guix/commit/637a34743d87b25d39f4a6c685b52b49b703e59a).

git-minimal `2.52.0` -> `2.54.0`
linux-libre-headers-6.1 `6.1.166` -> `6.1.177` -> `6.18.41`
python-lief `0.17.5` -> `1.0.0`
python-minimal `3.11.14` -> `3.12.12`

Default Clang/LLVM updated to `22.x`.
